name: cowart-thinking-canvas
description: A source-grounded thinking canvas with reversible edits and reviewable product workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Turn sources into editable canvases, semantic diagrams, PRDs, and prototypes.
interface.longDescription: Yogurt AI extends the tldraw-powered Cowart workspace with source-aware material cards, compact canvas context, atomic reasoning operations, guarded undo, annotation-driven editing, native editable semantic diagrams with a safe SVG precision route, and separately reviewable product workspaces for PRDs and interactive prototypes.
defaultPrompt: Open Yogurt AI for this project.
Organize these documents into source-linked cards and relationships on the canvas.
Turn my selected Yogurt notes into a traceable semantic line diagram directly on the current canvas.
Turn my selected notes and TAPD references into an interactive PRD, then preview a snapshot to sync back.
